title: Capture the PCB 3D view as a PNG image
summary: Switches the active board to 3D with the PCB:SwitchTo3D process, takes the document view's window handle and saves a PrintWindow capture as PNG; shows that PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT is needed to capture the 3D canvas.
phrasings: save a screenshot of the 3D board view
export the PCB view to an image file
switch the PCB to 3D from code
get the window handle of a document view

commands.name: PcbToImage
commands.description: Switch the PCB view to 3D and save the view window as a PNG
commands.params: Out=<file or folder> (optional, default: temp folder, file PcbToImage.png)|FullContent=true (optional)
